subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `sessions.list` permanently expose this Gateway-owned, additive presentation object—with open string classifications—as the supported cross-client session-navigation contract?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive and addresses duplicated parsing, but the permanence and semantics of a generated Gateway protocol surface require maintainer product and protocol ownership judgment.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the open-vocabulary presentation object as the supported client contract and merge after the branch is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Reduce or rename fields before merge if maintainers want a smaller long-term Gateway promise, then update generated clients and focused tests together.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the open-vocabulary presentation object as the supported client contract and merge after the branch is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository-member sponsor of both the canonical request and this implementation proposal.
